result_text:
I changed `DataExporter.java` in the `reports` module (around line 641). `all_files.zip` now takes its five entries from the configured scope aspects. It no longer uses fixed `aspect_*.txt` literals.

For each aspect (main, test, generated, build and deployment, other) it builds the entry name with `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`. That is the same call that wrote the loose text files, so the zip looks up the names the files were written under. With the default configuration the entries and their order are unchanged. With `buildAndDeployment` as the aspect name, the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`. `git-history.zip` is written again, because the failed read no longer aborts the export before that step.

The `reports` module compiles. I didn't run any tests or an export with a renamed aspect, so the renamed-aspect case is untested.
